name: bumble:futurespace
description: Coding and robotics courses for kids 8–14 using the mbot2 platform. Hands-on programming, real hardware, small groups.

skills.name: Course Information
skills.description: Provides details about bumble:futurespace coding and robotics courses for kids. Covers both beginner (Robot Explorer, ages 8–10, block coding, €25) and intermediate (Code the Machine, ages 11–14, Python, €40) tracks.

skills.name: Course Comparison
skills.description: Helps parents choose between Robot Explorer (beginner, block coding, ages 8–10, €25, 8 weeks) and Code the Machine (intermediate, Python, ages 11–14, €40, 10 weeks). Explains prerequisites, what's included, and which course fits a child's age and experience.
